turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Leo! Happy Friday. How is your morning going so far in Austin?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's going pretty well. Just sitting here in my oversized hoodie, trying to wake up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: An oversized hoodie sounds like the perfect cozy vibe for a Friday. Did you grab a morning coffee yet, or are you easing into the day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I had a matcha latte this morning. Trying to keep the caffeine a bit lower like the doctor suggested at my check-up, and it actually hit the spot.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a great choice, and glad to hear it was satisfying! How are things looking at the logistics firm today? Is it a busy Friday for an account coordinator, or is it winding down?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, it's pretty quiet. I've got a couple of shipments to track, but nothing major. I'm hoping to log off on time and maybe head to the climbing gym later.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, nice! Are you working on any specific routes at the climbing gym lately, or just going to get some practice in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's this V4 boulder problem I've been project-ing. I hope I can finally send it today. But first, I need to think about food. I'm actually about to eat my deli sandwich for lunch.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good luck with the V4 project! You've got this. And a deli sandwich sounds like a classic Friday lunch. Did you make it yourself?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I made it at home. Just a simple vegetarian deli sandwich with some chips. Sam actually bought some really good sourdough bread yesterday, so I used that.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Awesome, fresh sourdough makes a huge difference! What are your plans for the rest of the weekend? Any guitar practice or wedding prep for Ana's big day in November?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I'll definitely play some guitar tomorrow. As for Ana's wedding, my mom called yesterday to talk about the rehearsal dinner, so that's starting to feel very real! But mostly, I'm just looking forward to a relaxing weekend.
